text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That race was incredible! I ran as fast as I
could,
and my body was red-hot!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! It's all thanks to
your
guidance!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I feel totally unstoppable right
now!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you to keep pushing me
to be the
very best!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Right! After all, my next opponent might
be even
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Okay, that's enough celebrating!
Starting
tomorrow, we aim for even
greater heights!
